name: Exam range
summary: Everyone's finals drawn as two weeks of mountains: each exam is a peak in its owner's color, as tall as they said it was scary, the valleys are when people can hang, and the first meadow after the last peak is where the end of finals dinner goes; add your exam, make it scarier, then lock the dinner as an event.
useWhen: when r we all done with exams
end of finals dinner when everyone's free??
post ur exam schedule so we can plan
can we hang at all during finals week
dontUseWhen: one person's study plan (use a reminder)
picking a weekend far ahead (use clear-skies or meeting-time)
